pretrain.source_policy: empty record sources use stage default before aggregation; null proportions=0; row normalization; zero-sum rows assigned 100% to Collect-Existed

posttrain.source_policy: empty record sources use stage default before aggregation; null proportions=0; row normalization; zero-sum rows assigned 100% to Human-Created

translation.name: Translation and Cross-Lingual Processing
translation.definition: Translation, transliteration, romanization, and cross-lingual understanding or question answering.

NLG.name: Natural Language Generation and Creative Interpretation
NLG.definition: Generation of factual, explanatory, structured-to-text, structured-output, and creative content; idea development; and interpretation or analysis of literary, artistic, and scriptural material.

summarization.name: Summarization and Compression
summarization.definition: Condensing and summarizing documents, news, dialogues, video transcripts, and specialized materials.

QA.name: Question Answering and Knowledge Access
QA.definition: Answering questions by generating, selecting, extracting, or judging answers, including factual, contextual, open-domain, and knowledge-based questions.

NLU.name: Natural Language Understanding and Modeling
NLU.definition: Semantic, lexical, and discourse interpretation; contextual inference; language modeling, prediction, and completion; and recognition or reconstruction of word and string patterns.

coding.name: Code, Software, and Web Operations
coding.definition: Generating, completing, modifying, repairing, explaining, searching, or executing programs and commands; generating API/function calls; and performing web automation workflows.

dialogue.name: Dialogue and Social Interaction
dialogue.definition: Open-domain and task-oriented dialogue, dialogue-state and act analysis, social responses, negotiation, tutoring, and role playing.

classification.name: Classification and Attribute Detection
classification.definition: Assigning categories or detecting attributes of words, sentences, documents, or user states, including sentiment, emotion, intent, topic, and language.

rewriting.name: Rewriting, Editing, and Correction
rewriting.definition: Rewriting, paraphrasing, simplifying, editing, correcting, reformatting, or changing the style of existing text.

math.name: Mathematical and Quantitative Analysis
math.definition: Mathematical reasoning, symbolic and numerical computation, statistical and demographic analysis, quantitative prediction, and temporal anomaly detection.

information_extraction.name: Information Extraction and Structuring
information_extraction.definition: Identifying entities, relations, events, arguments, spans, and other structured information in text.

general_IF.name: General Instruction Following and Meta-Tasks
general_IF.definition: General instruction following, task execution, alignment, and broad or meta-level task labels not assigned to a specific capability.

reasoning.name: Reasoning, Decision Making, and Planning
reasoning.definition: Logical, causal, commonsense, probabilistic, and argumentative reasoning, together with planning, ordering, reflection, and complex decision making.

domain_specific.name: Domain-Specific Analysis and Practical Guidance
domain_specific.definition: Specialized question answering, analysis, and applications, together with practical advice, procedural instructions, planning, and generation of operational or educational materials.

safety_and_ethics.name: Safety, Ethics, Bias, and Factuality
safety_and_ethics.definition: Detecting harmful content, jailbreak attempts, bias, ethical concerns, misinformation, factual inconsistency, and unverifiable claims.

evaluation.name: Evaluation, Ranking, and Verification
evaluation.definition: Verifying answers, evaluating output quality or usability, ranking candidates, and reviewing generated content.

linguistic_analysis.name: Linguistic Analysis and Sequence Labeling
linguistic_analysis.definition: Morphological, syntactic, grammatical, stylistic, and token- or sequence-level analysis, including parsing, segmentation, and linguistic probing.

retrieval.name: Retrieval, Search, and Recommendation
retrieval.definition: Retrieving, matching, searching for, or recommending information from documents, knowledge bases, websites, and candidate collections.

pretrain.name: Raw Text Pre-training
pretrain.definition: Language-model pre-training on raw text without task-specific instruction or response annotations.

statistical_scope.inventory: All ISO 639-3 identifiers with Type L; includes macrolanguages. No alias merging.
statistical_scope.family: Preserve direct joined families. Missing macrolanguage families are inferred only when every member in the full Glottolog workbook has the same nonempty family name and glottocode, including non-living members. Detail files record the assignment method and member codes; language glottocodes and resource quantities are not inherited.
statistical_scope.coverage: Retained reduced records in this snapshot; not confirmed global availability.
statistical_scope.counts: Collections/datasets count unique collection names and (collection, dataset id) pairs across exported living languages, not the entire unfiltered inventory.
statistical_scope.cluster_minus_one: Uncovered OR records with no usable positive quantity; inspect status.
statistical_scope.allocation: Quantities are already allocated across each original record language list and equally across its category labels by Group/Reduce.
statistical_scope.nulls: Unknown/unavailable is null, not zero. Uncovered quantities are null. Partial known sums exclude null contributions.
statistical_scope.proportions: Fractions in [0,1], not percentages. Detail statistics retain reduced counts/proportions, including categories outside the five clustering sources.
statistical_scope.cluster_sources: Normalized five-category proportions from saved fitted results; cluster summaries are language-equal means. Stage defaults may impute missing sources.
statistical_scope.transforms: No plotting power transform or display-only CI expansion. No log conversion for displayed quantities.
statistical_scope.ci95: Original reduced pre-training NCC bounds; inherit upstream estimation assumptions, not between-language boxplot quartiles.
statistical_scope.regimes: Five plot-defined development regimes plus neither-stage-eligible and other to retain all identifiers.
